blockers.summary: A unified cross-platform engineering runner now exists at tools/run_release_checks.py and normal CI is separated from the intentionally failing final readiness gate. VERIFY-001 remains open until the full runner succeeds from a clean checkout on supported environments.

Executable example pairs, canonical JSON/Lattice vectors, permission/segment adversarial checks, and Hypothesis permission-preservation tests exist. TEST-001 remains open for broader mutation/fuzz/resource/migration coverage and final production corpus review.

A dependency-free independent JavaScript canonical JSON implementation now consumes multiple shared byte vectors and rejects non-core permission channels. INTEROP-001 remains open until its execution is recorded successfully alongside the Python conformance suite.
Implement and verify the SLAI v2.3 integration target: pinned LSTP under SLAI/model/LSTP, SLAI-root run_lstp.py adapter, validation/conversion boundary, and end-to-end human/LANTRA/agent smoke tests.
Synchronize the Level-1 Whitepaper publication with the reconciled v0.1 contract, remove stale maturity claims, and produce a reproducible publication build/source-figure set.

Perform the final clean release/pre-training audit: compatibility/migration statement, package provenance, clean install evidence, conformance/interop/SLAI evidence, version freeze, and explicit training-ready sign-off.
